svg.aria-label: The six metadata questions applied to the Lab 12 data
svg.title: The six metadata questions, applied to the fire response data

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Reading the metadata: the six questions from CCE 114

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every answer comes from READ-ME-FIRST.txt and the UGRC services' own descriptions. Check them yourself.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHAT

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What do the data represent?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A road NETWORK: segments joined at junctions,

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each with minutes to drive it (41,460 edges).

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 42 fire stations (points). 10,092 Census

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: blocks with the 2020 count of people, PP_TOTAL.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHERE

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Where, and in what coordinate system?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Utah County only: roads with the county on

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: either side, stations and blocks inside it.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: NAD 1983 UTM zone 12N, meters, every layer;

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the services themselves serve Web Mercator.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHEN

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: When were the data collected?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Roads updated through September 23, 2026.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stations: 'Last Update: September 22, 2022'

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (the service was re-saved March 2026). Blocks:

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Census Day, April 1, 2020. Four different dates.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHY

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Why were they created?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Roads: 'cartography and range based-address

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: location' and UDOT's linear referencing; 'a

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: network analysis dataset ... can also be derived'.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stations: 'to show the locations'. Blocks: no why.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How were they collected and processed?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Minutes 'estimated from the CARTOCODE field ...

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and the SPEED_LMT field', surface streets x 1.5:

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 'typical network travel, and not the expedited

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: travel of emergency response vehicles'.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHO

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Who maintains them, and may you use them?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The Utah Geospatial Resource Center (roads,

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the network, stations); the U.S. Census Bureau

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (blocks, published by UGRC). Public data under

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: CC BY: credit each source on your maps.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The stations layer says 'Last Update: September 22, 2022' and the blocks layer has no description at all. A station

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: opened since 2022 is not in your model, and a block's people are where they slept on April 1, 2020. Say in your report

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: what each of those does to your count of people outside four minutes, and which one you would fix first.
